dataset.name: Dutch heavy vehicle tax (belasting zware motorrijtuigen, Eurovignette)
dataset.method: Wet belasting zware motorrijtuigen, art. 10 (as in force on 1 January 2024, unchanged until 25 March 2025): the tax for a day is € 12 for every vehicle. Replaced on 25 March 2025 by the amounts by CO2 class.
dataset.publisher: carbon-cost (majidkabir/carbon-cost), compiled from the sources listed
